name: Future Echo
subtitle: Pause before an impulse purchase
promotional_text: Compare a purchase moment with a savings promise you chose, then Wait, Skip, or Keep without shame or scoring.
description: Future Echo creates a quiet, private pause before an unplanned purchase. Set one savings promise, enter the amount in front of you, and see a simple on-device comparison. A twelve-second echo gives you space to choose Wait 24 Hours, Skip Purchase, or Keep Purchase. Waiting creates a Cooling Card you can revisit later. Your Echo Trail records decisions without claiming that skipped money entered a real savings account. Purchase context stays on your device. Future Echo does not connect to a bank, execute payments, or provide financial advice.
privacy_policy_summary: Promises, cooling cards, decisions, and preferences stay on this device. No login, bank connection, payment execution, advertising tracker, cloud AI, or financial advice.
